publication_summary.raw_artifacts: project-local support data only; not canon; not approved memory; not candidates by themselves; not training data
publication_summary.t002_decision_summary: raw artifacts are project-local support data only; manifest-backed by manifest.json; artifact_files include artifact_file_id, relative_path, sha256, source_refs, evidence_refs, provenance_refs, and source_locator_refs; bundle_hash and manifest/content hash preserve integrity; invalid bundles are rejected or quarantined; indexes are derived/rebuildable support data only
publication_summary.manifest_boundary: raw artifact persistence must be manifest-backed, path-safe, and fail-closed
publication_summary.provenance_boundary: raw artifact persistence must preserve source/evidence/provenance linkage
publication_summary.promotion_boundary: raw artifact persistence must not automatically create candidates and must not automatically promote to canon
publication_summary.runtime_boundary: raw artifact persistence must not call models, must not trigger extraction, must not install/run/import BookNLP or spaCy, must not call NCP/Subtxt/dramatica-flow runtimes, and must not generate prose
